text:
Ana (Partnerships): Quick sync — we have the marketplace listing gated behind an embargo and we need final confirmations for press, landing, and partner assets. Posting a short checklist, pls ack with ✅/❌ and owners.

Ana (Partnerships): Checklist:
• Press embargo time (preferred): 08:00 PT 2026-06-10
• Final press quote from VP Partnerships (Sarah)
• Landing page ready in staging with CTA + partner logos
• Hardware partner logo redlines signed-off by Legal (Kate)
• SI integration doc & sample invoice for marketplace listing (Thomas/Leo)
• SKU / billing tier and pricing text for marketplace catalog (James)
• Marketplace support contact and SLA blurb

James (Marketing): ✅ I can draft the press email and pricing blurb. Need Sarah's quote by EOD tomorrow.

Sarah (Comms): I can send a VP quote draft by 5pm PT. @James — want a shorter soundbite or a longer paragraph?

James (Marketing): Short punchy quote preferred, one sentence. We'll build the longer press release if needed.

Leo (Product): Thomas — can you confirm the SI integration doc link? I pushed a new sample invoice to drive: https://drive.redwood/example-invoice-v2 (preview only).

Thomas (Eng): I uploaded the SI integration draft to the shared repo: https://git.redwood/si-marketplace/docs. It's missing the quickstart snippet and a small note on auth scopes — will add today.

Kate (Legal): For partner logos, need a signed redline from the partner and our standard trademark addendum. If you send the logos + partner contact I can ping them. Deadline to get legal sign-off is 06-08 COB.

Ana (Partnerships): Noted. @Kate — I'll email the partner contacts now. @Sarah — can you drop the quote in #comm-approvals so Legal can check trademark phrasing?

Sarah (Comms): Dropping quote in #comm-approvals in 10. Draft: “Partnering with X lets our customers scale inference faster and cheaper—bringing enterprise-grade performance to new workloads.” Thoughts?

James (Marketing): Nice. Tweak: swap 'cheaper' for 'more cost-effectively' to be press-safe.

Sarah (Comms): Updated and posted.

Thomas (Eng): Quickstart snippet I plan to add:
```
POST /marketplace/deploy
{
  "model_id": "rw-infer-v1",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "billing_sku": "RW-MP-STD"
}
```
Will add auth scopes note by 3pm PT.

Ana (Partnerships): Who owns the landing page final QA? We need to verify: responsive header, partner logo alt tags, CTA routing to trial flow, and analytics pixel firing.

Leo (Product): I can do the QA pass at 4pm PT, please give me the staging URL.

Ana (Partnerships): Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.com/marketplace/partner-unveil. Password: redwood-stg! (will rotate after QA).

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch marketplace-landing at 1934567105 — staging build #412.

Sarah (Comms): Small content nit: partner name capitalization needs to match partner brand guidlines. Kate, Legal ok to allow exact brand name?

Kate (Legal): OK to use partner brand capitalization as long as we include partner trademark notice in footer. I will send the two-line TM text.

James (Marketing): Pricing copy for SKU RW-MP-STD — proposed: "Pay-as-you-go per inference unit; volume discounts apply; see terms." Any objections?

Thomas (Eng): From engineering side, confirm SKU aligning with billing provider — I need the exact SLA metadata to wire monitoring cost metrics.

Leo (Product): SLA blurb: "99.9% uptime SLA for Dedicated customers; best-effort for free tier." James, is that OK for marketplace?

James (Marketing): We should avoid SLA percentages in marketplace text — suggest: "SLA-backed dedicated capacity available for qualifying customers." Legal ok?

Kate (Legal): Agree with James — avoid explicit % in public copy. Use James' suggested phrasing.

Ana (Partnerships): Outstanding blockers list (quick):
• Final partner redline + logos (owner: Ana / Kate) — deadline 06-08 COB
• Sarah's quote posted (done) — owner: Sarah
• SI doc quickstart + auth note (owner: Thomas) — deadline today 3pm PT
• Staging QA (owner: Leo) — 4pm PT
• Marketing copy for SKU + marketplace listing (owner: James) — EOD

Sarah (Comms): All good from comms side. I also scheduled a 30min pre-embargo readout 06-09 09:00 PT — invite sent.

Ana (Partnerships): Perfect. If everyone hits their bits, we can keep the embargo 08:00 PT 06-10. If any blocker shows up, we pull to the fallback cadence and postpone by 24h. :white_check_mark:

James (Marketing): ✅ ack — I'll post the final marketplace listing copy in this thread when ready.

Thomas (Eng): Adding auth scopes note now.

Leo (Product): Will start QA in 15.

Kate (Legal): I'll chase partner for signature if I don't have it by 2pm PT and report back here.

Ana (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — feel free to ping me directly for quick approvals.

James (Marketing): Final copy posted: "Redwood Inference is now available in the Cloud Marketplace — deploy models with one click, and manage capacity across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Learn more and try a free trial." Posting to marketplace portal now.

Ana (Partnerships): Closing loop — last_message: James posted final copy and deploy-bot completed staging build. If no objections, we keep embargo for 08:00 PT 06-10.

deploy-bot: staging build #412 succeeded at 1934567310.

Sarah (Comms): No objections from comms. :tada:

Kate (Legal): No legal blocks as long as TM footer included.

Thomas (Eng): SI doc quickstart added and pushed at 1934567200.

Leo (Product): QA pass done, minor CSS tweak filed #548 and fixed.

Ana (Partnerships): Great job team — I'll roll this into the launch checklist and send final confirmations tomorrow morning.
